title: Past Simple: regular verbs
summary: Use Past Simple for finished actions in the past.

explanation.en: Regular verbs form the Past Simple with -ed. Use did/didn't for questions and negatives.
explanation.ru: Правильные глаголы образуют Past Simple с помощью -ed. В вопросах и отрицаниях используется did/didn't.

examples.ru: В прошлом году мы посетили Лондон.

forms.label: Spelling
forms.pattern: live → lived · study → studied · stop → stopped

commonMistakes.note: After didn't, use the base form.
After did, use the base form.
